drink_composition.basis: near-neutral coconut milk; 8 % sugar; ideal water activity (Raoult); no preservative assumed

lag_h0.basis: Baranyi lag parameter for cold-stressed cells, typical 1 to 3; lag = h0 / mu

damage_radius_m.basis: order of plant cell-wall thickness after freeze rupture; log-uniform

5 um.basis: Washburn climb of the full 100 mm wrap, drink viscosity 1 mPa s, 76 degree contact angle

10 um.basis: Washburn climb of the full 100 mm wrap, drink viscosity 1 mPa s, 76 degree contact angle

15 um.basis: Washburn climb of the full 100 mm wrap, drink viscosity 1 mPa s, 76 degree contact angle
